verdict.rationale: Cake documents option grants with NSO/ISO workflows, automated board sign-off and e-signing flows, and a 409A valuation included in the cap table plan, so the pieces of the story exist in the product. Nothing shows the 409A value setting or checking the grant's strike price, or that these steps run as one connected issuance workflow. missing for 10: evidence that the 409A valuation sets or validates the option strike price, documentation of a single end-to-end grant flow from offer through board approval to issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
